source: Independent local Monte Carlo; no third-party hand tables
range_definition: Complete hand types ranked by generated heads-up random equity, including the type that crosses each 40%,15%,5% combination-mass boundary
range_sampling: Uniform legal combinations after removal of known hero and board cards
limitations: Ranges are models rather than human ranges or equilibrium ranges
Range ordering itself contains finite Monte Carlo noise
No official interface, blind schedule or payout information was provided
